automated.summary: MIS budget loader (POST /api/ingest/budget) extending the ingest module. Hermetic tests (no DB): ingest.controller.test.ts asserts the budget route is in the strict allow-list, guarded by AuthGuard + RequireAction('ingest'), rejects CSRF-less/forbidden, documents the multipart DTO; mis-budget.parser.test.ts asserts Table-2 header-set identification, every date-headed month block present (two in the fixture; YTD/FY skipped), GL line vs component group rows, the exact 'Roll Over Budget' sub-column, Actual/% ignored, every field as provided (format_id nursery-mis-financial-v1, cost_center = Budget Components label), paise amounts, formula cells accepted ONLY via a cached numeric result (uncached = rows.<n>.<column> diagnostic, never 0.00), blank -> 0.00, and preflight rejection of duplicate grain / a GL row missing S.No or component / zero GL rows; ingest.service.test.ts asserts validate-whole-workbook-before-any-write, NO repository call on invalid, per-period replaceBudgetBatch inside ONE outer transaction, and a later-period failure rolling back earlier ones (repository mocked), sap_transaction never touched. The jszip pre-materialization guard is extracted to a shared workbook-guard.ts used by both parsers.
